title: CMC fear-and-greed dated latest value merged into daily chart with reopen refresh
changes: Merge CoinMarketCap /api/latest into the existing 1-year daily history only when its own date is verifiable; no synthetic missing days.
Reopening the existing fear-and-greed popup refreshes official CMC data after 60s; a visible popup checks every 15 minutes.
Explicit chart latest UTC day, missing-day and stale-data status. Keep verified graph on transient errors.
Restore the requested ?limit=370 to the existing CMC Worker historical request; no Worker, new price API, indicators or drawing modifications.
requiredDeploy: Overwrite the five files under MultiAssetLiquidityRadar. Cloudflare Worker unchanged.
validationNote: Browser integration tests use mocked CMC dated historical/latest data. Actual Worker/live response has not been accessible from this environment.
